has_more.description:
Whether there are more results available.

If `true`, there are additional results that can be fetched using the `next_page` token.
has_more.title: Has More

next_page.description:
Token for fetching the next page of results.

If `null`, there are no more results available. Pass this value to the `page` parameter in the next request to get the next page.
next_page.title: Next Page

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the skill was created.
created_at.title: Created At

display_title.description:
Display title for the skill.

This is a human-readable label that is not included in the prompt sent to the model.
display_title.title: Display Title

id.description:
Unique identifier for the skill.

The format and length of IDs may change over time.
id.title: Id

latest_version.description:
The latest version identifier for the skill.

This represents the most recent version of the skill that has been created.
latest_version.title: Latest Version

source.description:
Source of the skill.

This may be one of the following values:
* `"custom"`: the skill was created by a user
* `"anthropic"`: the skill was created by Anthropic
source.title: Source

type.description:
Object type.

For Skills, this is always `"skill"`.
type.title: Type

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the skill was last updated.
updated_at.title: Updated At
